MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

2. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Melody.

3. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   B. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   D. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Replace drinking water

5. Best practice when working on Singing Games: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Singing Games.
   B. Damage equipment used for Singing Games.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Singing Games.
   D. Practise Singing Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.
   B. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.

7. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The ticket price
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the costume

8. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.
   B. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.
   D. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Dance.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Dance.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Dance.

10. Best practice when working on Elements of Music RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Elements of Music RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Elements of Music RESPONDING.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm COMPOSING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Singing Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm COMPOSING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
